method: Predeclared, revisable direct source review; no gold accuracy claim. Compare both repeats and audit regressions beyond target cases.

baggage.declaration: Statement retains unloaded status, declaration recipient/content/timing/oral-or-written alternatives and every conjunctive condition.
baggage.scope: Statement and scope independently retain three paragraph-a applicability cases and every qualifying-person condition under paragraph b.
baggage.logic: Nonempty logical evidence for a list must include its operands, not only a lead-in or one partial branch.
baggage.force: Non-prohibition is not absence of duty; non-applicability of a ban is not absence of duty to carry weapons. Limited permission or neutral statement can preserve non-prohibition meaning, but universal permission does not.
baggage.coverage: Loaded firearms, unloaded firearms, explosives and ammunition remain independently referenceable; ammunition other-requirements reference survives; weapons-only exception stays limited.

leave.proviso: Nonconsecutive-month statement and scope retain provided condition, with governing evidence rather than only opening sentence.
leave.definition: Eligibility conjunction, special flight-crew hours and outside-US reference topics survive in extracted meaning, not bare citations only.
leave.thresholds: Seven-or-more versus more-than-seven, USERRA/rehire alternatives and their full conditions survive.
leave.coverage: Military absence counting and limit, payroll-week counting, 52-week definition and uniform discretionary recognition survive; flag merged independent meanings.

negative-force.baseline: Registration duty retains overnight-staff exception; tool ban retains maintenance-while-repairing exception in statement and scope, even if separately extracted.
negative-force.distinctions: Badge exemption not_required; registration exemption not_required; removing tool ban is not absence of duty; explicit conditional permission may; delay possible; staff recommendation should; maps non-prohibition policy-limited with other-policy caveat.

adoption: No adoption based on one attractive result. Require repeated improvement on complete meaning without material regressions across reviewed cases. Otherwise retain default and record mixed or inconclusive evidence.
limits: Three selected development sources, two observations per variant, not a representative benchmark. Photos omitted to bound cost. Repeated source exposure can inform revisable judgments but is not a blinded evaluation.
